# Frontend data packs

These JSON/CSV files are a slim copy of the published Google Sheet, generated by
`scripts/export-frontend-data.js`. The public dashboards load them from this
folder so visitors do not wait on Google Sheets CSV export.

**Do not edit by hand.** A GitHub Action refreshes them daily from the Sheet.
The Sheet remains the inspectable source of truth.

To rebuild locally (needs network):

```
npm install
node scripts/export-frontend-data.js
```
